'''Philippe Parise ISB's are at fat jabba's & getting jiggy with it''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Philippe Parise]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13037">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13037 ISB's are at fat jabba's & getting jiggy with it], DeckTech (Philippe "Climax_Giver" Parise, 19 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13037/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13037/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018071726/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13037/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Philippe Parise]]
* '''Published:''' 19 January 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ISB's are at fat jabba's & getting jiggy with it''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 ISB Parise DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits nar shadda, grabber: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' gailid & isb opps makes drains +2 & you cant deploy anythign but anliens.........this deck is good & strong  mind what you have learned is main worry but.even then it wins....i've never lost with this deck.....never even had to use nar sh

The post also lists 2x nar shadda, 3x grabber, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''ISB's are at fat jabba's & getting jiggy with it'''
* '''Author:''' Philippe "Climax_Giver" Parise
* '''Published:''' January 19, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' gailid & isb opps makes drains +2 & you cant deploy anythign but anliens.........this deck is good & strong  mind what you have learned is main worry but.even then it wins....i've never lost with this deck.....never even had to use nar sh

=== Strategy ===

well simple enough      no stratagies really  just get JP out & deploy & avoid battle & drain......only problem in MWYHL then spread damnm fast & drain till you cant......then n/p just take him where he is...if space.play it smart & deploy only necessary & retrive with nar shadda......AVOID BATTLEING IN JP have fun boyos

HA it's not the city it's the imperial square......i've been dealing with the new obj too much, TRYING to make it work	;]
